concepts.name: Major Global Environmental Changes Water
concepts.simple_definition: Major Global Environmental Changes Water hyacinth (Eichhornia crassipes) is another emergent aquatic perennial that develops rosettes of thick, spongy leaves
concepts.deep_explanation: It’s native to South America, but it’s now found on every continent except Antarctica, and its distribution is likely to expand as the temperature warms
